capabilities: Set weekly study goals and task pools per subject
Record daily habit check-ins and task outcomes
Generate weekly and monthly reports with trend CSV
Import weekly plans from AI-generated JSON
extras: README is mostly in Chinese and points to an external product spec for final score rules; records are stored as Markdown revisions under LifePilot/Data with backups and branch conflict resolution; DeepSeek proposals must be approved by the user in Obsidian; MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to combine weekly study goals, daily habit check-ins, and progress scoring in one place.

relations.evidence: Fast Note Sync and DeepSeek Harness are optional, separately configured integrations.
DeepSeek 小鱼可通过 MCP 查询进度或提交提案，提案由用户在 Obsidian 批准。
启用 Dayline Journal 后，「打开日记」优先打开该插件日记目录里当天的已有日记。

summary: Offline study planner and habit tracker that sets weekly exam goals, logs daily check-ins, and reviews scores and reports in Obsidian.
